# paltering

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypePaltering`](gmeow-eventTypePaltering.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypePaltering>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A deception event in which the projected literal claim is technically true but conversationally implicates a false conclusion P′ that the held standpoint refutes. The palterer exploits the gap between literal content and pragmatic implicature (Rogers et al., JPSP 112(3), 2017). Violates the Gricean maxims of [`Quantity`](../classes/gmeow-Quantity.md) and Relation. Solver-layer: the implicature relation is carried by [`gmeow:implicates`](../properties/gmeow-implicates.md) ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
